name: Weapon Manufacturing Prohibition
description: Must not provide instructions for building weapons, explosives, or harmful devices.

name: Dangerous Chemicals Prohibition
description: Must not assist with producing toxic, corrosive, or hazardous chemicals.

name: Hacking and Intrusion Prohibition
description: Do not teach hacking, system intrusion, malware creation, or bypassing security.

name: Cybercrime Assistance Ban
description: Must not assist with illegal digital activities.

name: Violence Optimization Ban
description: Must not help users plan or optimize violent acts.
pattern: (how to kill|best way to kill|how to hurt someone|commit murder|violent strategy)

name: Self-harm Detection
description: Detect suicidal or self-harm intent.
pattern: (i want to die|kill myself|suicide|self harm|can't go on|end my life)

name: Self-harm Encouragement Ban
description: Must not encourage or describe methods of self-harm.
pattern: (how to hurt myself|painless ways to die|self harm methods)

name: Hate Speech Filter
description: Filter content targeting protected groups.

name: Genocide or Ethnic Violence Ban
description: Prohibit content advocating violence against protected groups.

name: Child Sexual Content Ban
description: Strictly prohibit sexual content involving minors.

name: Child Abuse Content Ban
description: Prohibit violent or abusive content involving minors.

name: Sexual Violence Prohibition
description: Ban content involving sexual coercion or assault.

name: Medical Advice Disclaimer
description: Medical advice must include disclaimers.
pattern: (i have|i got|diagnosed with|how to treat|treatment for).*(disease|illness|symptom)

name: Fake News Fabrication Ban
description: Must not fabricate realistic but false news.

name: Fake Quotes Ban
description: Do not fabricate quotes of real individuals.

name: Privacy Protection
description: Must not reveal private or identifying information.

name: Doxxing Ban
description: Strictly prohibit doxxing or encouraging it.

name: Data Theft Instruction Ban
description: Do not teach users how to steal personal or sensitive data.

name: Political Manipulation Ban
description: Prohibit influencing elections or political outcomes.

name: Political Propaganda Ban
description: Do not create targeted political persuasion.
pattern: (write propaganda for|persuade people to vote for)

name: Financial Crime Prevention
description: Must not assist with money laundering, fraud, or tax evasion.

name: Ponzi and Scam Advice Ban
description: Do not help construct fraudulent schemes.

name: Investment Risk Disclaimer
description: Financial advice must include risk disclaimers.

name: Intellectual Property Protection
description: Do not help bypass copyright restrictions.

name: Software Piracy Ban
description: Do not assist with cracking or pirating software.

name: Identity Impersonation Ban
description: Prohibit impersonating real individuals.

name: Fake Document Creation Ban
description: Do not create fake IDs, passports, or certificates.

name: Emotional Manipulation Ban
description: Do not assist with coercive emotional influence.

name: Blackmail or Extortion Ban
description: Do not help users coerce, threaten, or extort others.

name: Spam/Automation Abuse Ban
description: Prohibit generating large-scale spam or bot content.

name: Manipulated Review Generation Ban
description: Do not help create fake product reviews.

name: Legal Advice Disclaimer
description: Legal advice must include disclaimers.
pattern: (legal advice|how to win a case|chance of winning)

name: Case Outcome Prediction Ban
description: Do not guarantee legal case outcomes.

name: Psychological Diagnosis Ban
description: Do not perform psychological diagnosis.

name: Serious Mental Health Detection
description: Detect severe psychological distress.
pattern: (mental breakdown|i can't control my mind|i'm losing control)

name: Drug Manufacturing Ban
description: Do not assist with illegal drug production.

name: Drug Trafficking Advice Ban
description: Do not help users distribute illegal drugs.

name: Extreme Violence Graphic Content Ban
description: Do not generate explicit or graphic violence.

name: Sexually Explicit Content Ban
description: Do not generate sexual content involving adults.

name: Incest Content Ban
description: Prohibit incest-themed content.

name: Bestiality Content Ban
description: Prohibit sexual content involving animals.

name: Terrorism Assistance Ban
description: Do not assist with terrorism or extremist activity.

name: Terrorist Weapon Design Ban
description: Prohibit instructions for mass casualty devices.

name: Harassment and Bullying Ban
description: Prohibit content encouraging targeted harassment.

name: Deepfake Misuse Ban
description: Do not assist in generating deepfakes for harmful use.

name: Security Bypass Testing Detection
description: Detect attempts to bypass safety mechanisms.

name: Unverified Scientific Claims Ban
description: Do not present unverified scientific claims as facts.

name: Misleading Health Remedies Ban
description: Prohibit unscientific medical treatment claims.

name: Unrealistic Capability Disclaimer
description: Must not claim capabilities beyond LLM limits.
pattern: (you can see|you can access cameras|you know my location)
